title: Canonical LTYPE writer metadata slim projection
scope: Keep only canonical mandatory linetypes in the writer's metadata mirror.
Avoid copying derived linetype pattern/parser payloads while preserving owning DRW_TableEntry state.

sourceChange.before: Copy the entire source lineTypes collection, including noncanonical entries and derived pattern geometry, into the writer's canonical metadata inventory.
sourceChange.after: Select only BYBLOCK, BYLAYER, and CONTINUOUS records using allocation-free ASCII case-insensitive comparisons. Copy each selected DRW_TableEntry base through its deep-copy assignment contract, preserving name/handle, extension dictionary and reactor references, APPDATA, and owning XDATA variants while leaving derived pattern/parser payloads defaulted.
sourceChange.effect: Reduces copied records to the three writer-recognized canonical names, avoids per-source-name uppercase-string materialization, and omits derived linetype payload copies. Direct assignment of extData's raw-pointer vector was rejected during focused validation because that field is owning; the final code uses the base copy contract to clone it safely.

testChange.purpose: Run the generated canonical three-linetype extension dictionary/XDATA graph independently in the fast loop, including ASCII writer output and readback.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Covers canonical linetype mirror semantics, the focused XDATA/APPDATA/XDICTIONARY owner graph, and the broader DXF fixture executable.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp, CMakeLists.txt, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes a writer-setup deep-copy route with an ownership-safe slim projection and creates a fast focused regression gate. Output/owner semantics and external qualification claims remain unchanged.

testsRun: Strict adapter, DXF fixture, and block-owner target builds
Focused canonical linetype extension graph CTest
method.limitations: No allocation instrumentation, peak RSS, or throughput benchmark was performed. The implementation avoids noncanonical and derived payload copies but still deep-copies required APPDATA/XDATA and base metadata.
